France.note: 'Rue' also appears in Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland and Monaco; check the plates (blue bands on both sides) to confirm France.

Italy.note: 'Via' is also used in San Marino and Ticino (Switzerland). Italian words end in vowels and only use accents like à è.

cam.Albania: Sky rift: a jagged purple / dark-blue stitching tear across the sky (Gen 3 camera quirk). Also seen in Montenegro.
cam.Montenegro: Sky rift: a jagged purple / dark-blue stitching tear across the sky (Gen 3 camera quirk). Also seen in Albania.
cam.Switzerland: Low camera: noticeably low, almost bumper-height viewpoint.
cam.South Africa: Google car: Gen 2 halo and round blur under the car; Gen 3 shows the back of a white car; Gen 4 a sky-blue car with a short black antenna.
cam.Namibia: Google car: white pickup with a short antenna on the front that leans slightly to the left (Oman's leans right).
cam.Botswana: Google car: the back of a white car is sometimes visible (the same car as South Africa, Eswatini and Lesotho).
cam.Eswatini: Google car: white car, back sometimes visible (same as South Africa).
cam.Lesotho: Google car: white car, back sometimes visible (same as South Africa).
cam.Kenya: Google car: a pickup or SUV with a thick black snorkel on the front right (older coverage); since 2022 a different truck that may show a snorkel, an antenna, both or neither.
cam.Uganda: Google car: boxy white SUV with a black bull bar on the front (often visible); in national parks a man with a rifle may follow the car.
cam.Rwanda: Google car: low camera on a black (sometimes white or grey) truck with heavy blurring; the camera mount is almost always visible.
cam.Tanzania: No car: trekker and boat coverage only; the trekker's shadow is sometimes visible.
cam.Nigeria: Google car: white or red pickup, roof rack sometimes with a yellow-and-black pattern; a police car or SUV (white, black, silver, red or tan) follows closely.
cam.Ghana: Google car: four silver roof-rack bars with black tape on the front-right bar (a rare car in central Ghana has none).
cam.Senegal: Sky rift: a jagged purple / dark-blue stitching tear across the sky, common outside Dakar (Gen 3). Gen 4 shows a white or silver truck cab.
cam.Mali: No car: Gen 3 trekker coverage only.
cam.Tunisia: Follow car: a light green Toyota north of Hammamet, a dark green Mazda south of it (none on Djerba).
cam.Egypt: No car: Gen 3 trekker only; a police escort is often in view.
cam.Madagascar: Coverage: mostly trekker and boat (west coast, Sambirano river); an ox cart and a short car stretch on the RN8.
cam.São Tomé and Príncipe: Google car: mostly a blurred black or green truck; on Príncipe a blue truck with a black antenna.
cam.Réunion: Google car: tape on the rear passenger-side roof bar (Ghana's tape sits on the front right).
